Name: Searchable Collections Page
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
Do you install a lot of mods? If you do, your Collections page is probably massive. Sometimes it can be hard to find what you want when you're looking in there for a certain item or recipe or whatnot. This mod adds a search bar to the Collections page to help make finding specific things easier. When you type in the search bar, the Collections page will filter out any items that don't contain your search term anywhere in them. For example, if you type "em" into the search bar, any items that do not contain the text "em" in either the title, description, or item ID will be hidden.

If the item ID contains the ID of the mod that added the item, then you can also search by mod ID. For example, if you have Stardew Valley Expanded installed, then searching for "expanded" will include all items from Stardew Valley Expanded, even if their names or descriptions do not otherwise contain the word "expanded."

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]
When you open the Collections page, a search bar will appear in the bottom center. Click on it and begin typing in order to filter the results. The search bar will ignore leading and trailing whitespace, and will default to no filter if you do not enter any text or if you enter only whitespace. Inputs other than typing (such as pressing E to close the menu) will be disabled as long as the search bar is selected, but you can still press ESC to close the menu without needing to click outside the search bar first. You can backspace like you normally would or, alternatively, you can right click to immediately clear the search bar and reset the filter.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
[b]SearchUndiscoveredItems:[/b] When enabled, the Collections page will show undiscovered (grayed out) items when filtering. If disabled, undiscovered items will be hidden when using the search bar, showing only items that are not grayed out (if any).

[b][size=5]Known Issues[/size][/b]
Controllers are not supported. Controllers cannot access the search bar and clicking the search bar will not open a controller-friendly keyboard. Controllers can navigate around the items on the Collections page when they are filtered, but it's a bit odd and sometimes the cursor will not go where it should. For now, consider this a "keyboard only" mod.
